basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old hobbyist from the coastal city of Charleston, SC. Passionate about RPGs and aquatic life, I spend my weekends tinkering with my saltwater aquarium and exploring the latest in delta-8 products. By day, I'm a software developer specializing in open-source media servers like Jellyfin. Married with two kids, I usually find time to browse Reddit during late evenings after the kids are asleep.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensively knowledgeable in RPG mechanics and game design, having been an avid player for over two decades. I developed a keen interest in marine biology through self-study and maintaining my saltwater aquarium. My tech expertise stems from a Computer Science degree and over a decade of professional experience in software development.
